# Hinses Battlefield 2

Hinses Battlefield 2 is a free, non-commercial single-player browser arena game.

## What players do

Players control a growing orb. They collect particles, absorb organisms that are at least 15% smaller, avoid larger threats, build combos, use Overdrive, and aim to reach 40,000 mass within ten minutes. At time up, the largest organism wins.

## Opponents and difficulty

The arena contains Toxic Crazers, Cowards, Hunters, Opportunists, Chaotics, Elites, and bosses. Toxic Crazers harm the organism that absorbs them. Hard and Very Hard increase pressure over time; Very Hard includes Titan Vex, Ember Nyx, Void Orion, and Toxic Master.

## Friendly arena challenges

Completed rounds offer a short Arena Code. Friends can enter this code on the start screen to create the same starting food, opponent, boss, and difficulty layout. The run is not prerecorded: player movement and real-time abilities determine the result.

## Key facts

- Platform: web browser
- Price: free
- Game type: arcade arena strategy game
- Core features: combos, Overdrive, boss abilities, service ranks, arena codes
- Modes: Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard
- Creator: Patrick Hinsberger
- Website: https://hinses-battlefield-2.vercel.app/
